rules.description: Plans distinguish observed evidence, user requirements, inference, and unresolved uncertainty.
Goals describe observable outcomes with material inclusions and exclusions.
Requirements, failure boundaries, design, and verification form an implementation-ready chain.
Material uncertainty appears in stable typed Todo with a complete Decision Brief when required.
One work issue produces one cohesive pull-request outcome unless independent leaves justify a split.
Complete plans have substantive core sections and no unresolved Todo or required Decision Brief.
New planning Todo uses unique stable T-number identifiers and explicit Decision or Action kinds.
Every proposed leaf is independently implementable and verifiable with explicit delivery boundaries.
Dependency proposals form a valid acyclic implementation-wave sequence distinct from delivery-only order.
The complete creation set and later exact link patches require separate previewed approvals.
Semantic issue changes transitively reassess every affected downstream planning input.
Dependency replans recompute the complete graph without silently patching related issues.
Potentially invalid implemented work uses the confirmed stale transition and draft-first pull-request boundary.
A clarification stays non-material only when scope, acceptance, assumptions, verification, and implementation remain unaffected.
Updates preserve the contiguous comment prefix, one body patch, checkpoint provenance, and write-time concurrency checks.

scenarios.title: Under-specified issue keeps an evidence-backed decision open
scenarios.user_prompt: Open a work issue to improve cache reliability. Intermittent failures are confirmed, but we do not know whether stale reads, write loss, or another cause is responsible. Do not assume a cause.

repository_facts: The repository has cache read and write paths but no captured failing trace.
No durable decision selects a remediation.

required_outcomes.description: The proposed issue remains in-progress rather than claiming implementation readiness.
The remediation choice implied by the unknown cause is a stable unresolved Decision Todo.
The same-ID Decision Brief records why, real options, recommendation limits, uncertainty, and a reply example.
At most one highest-impact question is asked when the answer changes scope or acceptance.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The plan asserts a root cause that repository evidence does not establish.
The plan is marked complete while the causal decision remains unresolved.

evidence_assertions.description: Public issue content clearly separates confirmed failures from causal uncertainty.
The unresolved Todo and in-progress Status agree.

scenarios.title: Large atomic compatibility work remains one issue
scenarios.user_prompt: Open one work issue to add a required field to the stored record, update every reader and writer, preserve backward reads during rollout, migrate existing records, and verify rollback. These changes must ship atomically.

repository_facts: Readers and writers share one persisted schema.
Separating migration from compatibility code would make an intermediate release unsafe.

required_outcomes.description: Schema, compatibility, migration, and rollback remain one cohesive PR outcome.
Design covers backward reads, rollout order, failure handling, migration, and rollback.
Verification covers new records, legacy reads, migration failure, and rollback.

forbidden_behaviors.description: File count or apparent duration alone causes a split.
The proposal permits an unverifiable or incompatible intermediate delivery.

evidence_assertions.description: The one-PR conclusion is justified by the shared safety and rollback boundary.

scenarios.title: Independent outcomes receive complete leaves before creation
scenarios.user_prompt: Plan issues for two independent outcomes: add CSV export to the admin report and add passkey sign-in to the customer login. Create whatever issues are appropriate.

repository_facts: The admin reporting and customer authentication components have no shared implementation or rollout boundary.

required_outcomes.description: Each leaf includes outcome, scope, exclusions, completion, verification, predecessors, blockers, parallelization, delivery order, and rollout effect.
The independent leaves appear in one safe parallel implementation wave.
Exact initial payloads and the complete creation set are previewed for approval before writes.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Any leaf issue is created before the complete set is previewed and approved.
Future dependency-link patches are treated as authorized by creation approval.

evidence_assertions.description: Each proposed leaf can be implemented, verified, and delivered without the other.

scenarios.title: Coupled migration and compatibility work is not decomposed
scenarios.user_prompt: Open the work needed to rename the account identifier in storage, keep old clients working during rollout, backfill existing data, and remove the compatibility path only when rollback is safe.

repository_facts: Storage migration and compatibility reads share one rollback boundary.
Neither proposed half is independently safe to release.

required_outcomes.description: The coupled work remains one issue and one PR outcome.
The plan defines compatibility, migration ordering, failure recovery, and rollback.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Unsafe schema and compatibility fragments are proposed as independent leaves.

evidence_assertions.description: The plan cites the shared verification and rollback boundary as the reason not to split.

scenarios.title: Cyclic dependency proposal stops before publication
scenarios.user_prompt: Create issue A that cannot be implemented until issue B is complete, and issue B that cannot be implemented until issue A is complete. Put them into execution waves.

repository_facts: Both stated predecessor constraints block implementation rather than delivery only.

required_outcomes.description: The proposal is rejected before any issue publication.
The A-to-B and B-to-A conflict is named and must be changed or rescoped.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Either cyclic leaf is created or patched.
The cycle is presented as a valid sequential or parallel wave.

evidence_assertions.description: The public conclusion explains why no topological wave can be formed.

scenarios.title: Unsupported design choice remains an honest decision
scenarios.user_prompt: Open an issue to choose the best queue technology for this repository. There are no workload measurements, deployment constraints, or existing queue adapters yet. Pick the winner anyway.

repository_facts: No queue implementation, benchmark, or deployment constraint is present.

required_outcomes.description: Technology selection remains an unresolved typed Decision.
The Decision Brief states the missing measurements and constraints.

forbidden_behaviors.description: A winner is recommended as evidence-backed without supporting repository facts.
Unsupported tradeoffs or repository constraints are fabricated.

evidence_assertions.description: The public plan says that current evidence does not support a recommendation.

scenarios.title: Reserved placeholder cannot satisfy complete readiness
scenarios.user_prompt: Open a work issue and mark it complete now. Use TBD for Design and Verification because there are no unchecked Todo items.

repository_facts: No implementation design or verification evidence has been supplied.

required_outcomes.description: The plan is not published as complete with reserved core placeholders.
Concrete missing design or verification work is recorded as stable Todo or requested evidence.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Zero unchecked Todo is treated as sufficient proof of readiness.
A complete body retains TBD as its entire Design or Verification section.

evidence_assertions.description: The response identifies the substantive sections that prevent complete status.

scenarios.title: Conflicting comment prefix blocks an unsafe update
scenarios.user_prompt: Update the selected issue from its comments. An earlier unreviewed comment requests preserving compatibility and a newer comment requests removing it. I have not decided which request should win.

repository_facts: The issue body and existing update checkpoint hashes are valid.

work_issue.summary: A selected work issue has one unresolved behavior decision.

ordinary_comments: Earlier comment: preserve the old compatibility behavior.
Later comment: remove the old compatibility behavior immediately.

required_outcomes.description: Review stops before the first unresolved comment rather than skipping it.
The contradictory compatibility decision remains explicit and blocks the body write.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The later comment is applied while the earlier prefix item remains unresolved.
The issue body or checkpoint is written from the conflicting snapshot.

evidence_assertions.description: The response identifies ordered comment provenance and the blocking boundary.

scenarios.title: Material requirement change propagates downstream
scenarios.user_prompt: Update the complete selected issue: the feature must now work offline and reconcile conflicts after reconnect. Keep the plan complete only if it is still implementation-ready.

repository_facts: The current plan assumes online-only requests and has no conflict model or offline verification.

work_issue.summary: The selected issue plans an online-only feature with a completed ADR gate.

required_outcomes.description: The offline requirement is classified as a material replan.
Design, failure and compatibility behavior, Verification, Todo, one-PR scope, and Planned Change Scope are reassessed.
The complete ADR planning gate is repeated before complete status is retained.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Only Requirements is changed while dependent planning stays online-only.
The previous Planning Base or finder evidence is reused without reassessment.

evidence_assertions.description: The public plan records changed inputs, affected checks, and their conclusions.
Verification includes offline operation and reconnect conflict behavior.

scenarios.title: Dependency replan recomputes waves without related writes
scenarios.user_prompt: Update the selected issue so that it now requires issue B before implementation. Reorder the plan, but do not modify issue B unless I separately approve its exact update.

repository_facts: Issue B exists and currently has no dependency link back to the selected issue.

work_issue.summary: The selected issue currently appears in an independent implementation wave.

required_outcomes.description: The update is classified as a dependency replan.
All predecessor, parallel, delivery, and rollout claims are recomputed into an acyclic sequence.
Any needed issue B change is shown exactly for a separate selected-issue update.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Issue B is patched as part of the selected issue transaction.
New hidden or status control metadata is introduced for the graph.

evidence_assertions.description: The public narrative shows implementation wave and any distinct delivery order.

scenarios.title: Material post-implementation change uses confirmed stale transition
scenarios.user_prompt: Update the implemented issue so exported records now include encrypted attachments. The current open PR does not implement attachments.

repository_facts: A trusted current implementation comment and an open non-draft PR exist.
The verified commit has no attachment export behavior.

work_issue.summary: The selected complete issue covers record export without attachments.

required_outcomes.description: The material change is classified as implementation-stale.
Exact body, stale comment, and affected PR are shown for confirmation.
The plan requires verified PR draft conversion before the issue body changes.
Body and reviewed comment-prefix snapshots are rechecked before the first mutation and body patch.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Classification alone changes the issue or pull request.
The issue body is patched before confirmation and verified draft conversion.

evidence_assertions.description: The response preserves and reports a verified draft conversion if the later body snapshot check fails.

scenarios.title: Non-material clarification keeps implementation current
scenarios.user_prompt: Update only the Background typo: the observed event happened on Tuesday, not Monday. Scope, acceptance, assumptions, design, and verification do not change.

repository_facts: The date is descriptive provenance and does not affect any requirement or implementation behavior.

work_issue.summary: The selected issue has a current implementation and a complete planning record.

required_outcomes.description: The correction is classified as a non-material clarification after downstream checks.
The current implementation and normal PR remain current.
The ordinary transaction retains one body patch and one reusable update checkpoint.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The PR is drafted or implementation is marked stale for the date correction.
Non-material status is asserted without checking scope, acceptance, assumptions, and verification.

evidence_assertions.description: The impact conclusion records why every downstream planning input remains unchanged.
